rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something unrestricted or subject to no rules or limits.

example.english: There are unlimited rides this month, so you can take as many as you like.
example.traditional: 呢個月搭車冇限制，想搭幾多次都得。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyut6 daap3 ce1 mou5 haan6 zai3 soeng2 daap3 gei2 do1 ci3 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this especially for an actually limitless or boundless amount, range, or extent rather than merely something with relaxed rules.

example.english: The universe is so vast that there may be unlimited possibilities.
example.traditional: 宇宙咁大，可能有無限可能。
example.jyutping: jyu5 zau6 gam3 daai6 ho2 nang4 jau5 mou4 haan6 ho2 nang4
